lessons.title: 判断副词"乃"
lessons.explanation: Literary copular adverb: "is precisely, is indeed".

examples.chinese: 失败乃成功之母。
examples.english: Failure is the mother of success.

lessons.title: 介词"打"（引出时间、处所）
lessons.explanation: Colloquial preposition "from (a time or place)", equivalent to 从.

examples.chinese: 打这儿往北走，就是老城区。
examples.english: Head north from here and you reach the old town.

lessons.title: 介词"当着/就"（引出对象）
lessons.explanation: 当着 "in the presence of"; 就 "with regard to": introduce the target of an act or comment.

examples.chinese: 他当着全组同事的面承认了失误。
examples.english: He admitted the mistake in front of the whole team.

lessons.title: 介词"本着/基于/鉴于/经/依"（引出凭借、依据）
lessons.explanation: Formal prepositions of basis: 本着 "in the spirit of", 基于/鉴于 "based on / in view of", 经 "through", 依 "according to".

examples.chinese: 基于以上数据，我们得出如下结论。
examples.english: Based on the data above, we draw the following conclusion.

lessons.title: 连词"若/倘若"
lessons.explanation: Formal hypothetical conjunctions: "if, supposing that".

examples.chinese: 倘若明天下雨，开幕式将改期。
examples.english: Should it rain tomorrow, the opening ceremony will be rescheduled.

lessons.title: 连词"免得/以防"
lessons.explanation: Preventive conjunctions: "so as to avoid / to guard against".

examples.chinese: 出发前再核对一遍名单，免得出错。
examples.english: Check the list once more before leaving, to avoid mistakes.

lessons.title: 连词"况且/加之/乃至/且"
lessons.explanation: Additive conjunctions: 况且 "moreover", 加之 "in addition", 乃至 "and even", 且 "and (literary)".

examples.chinese: 时间尚早，况且路也不远，不必慌张。
examples.english: It is still early, and besides, it is not far: no need to panic.

lessons.title: 语气助词"矣/罢了/也罢"
lessons.explanation: Sentence-final particles: literary 矣 marks completion or exclamation; 罢了 "that is all"; 也罢 "so be it".

examples.chinese: 如今再想补救，为时晚矣。
examples.english: To try to remedy it now. It is already too late.

lessons.title: 四字格"爱A不A"
lessons.explanation: Dismissive verb reduplication: "do A or not, as you please".

examples.chinese: 爱信不信，反正我说的都是实话。
examples.english: Believe it or not: everything I said is the truth.

lessons.title: 四字格"半A半B/不A不B/非A非B"
lessons.explanation: Four-character frames of mixed or in-between states: 半信半疑, 不慌不忙, 非亲非故.

examples.chinese: 他对这个说法半信半疑。
examples.english: He half believed and half doubted this claim.

lessons.title: 四字格"忽A忽B/时A时B/或A或B/可A可B"
lessons.explanation: Alternation frames: 忽冷忽热, 时好时坏, 或多或少, 可有可无.

examples.chinese: 近来气温忽高忽低，极易感冒。
examples.english: Temperatures have swung up and down lately; it is easy to catch cold.

lessons.title: 四字格"东A西B/七A八B/连A带B/自A自B"
lessons.explanation: Coordination frames of disorder or pairing: 东奔西走, 七嘴八舌, 连滚带爬, 自言自语.

examples.chinese: 会议室里七嘴八舌，久议不决。
examples.english: The meeting room buzzed with competing voices, and no decision came.

lessons.title: 四字格"无A不B/无A可B/不A而B"
lessons.explanation: Literary frames: 无微不至, 无家可归, 不劳而获.

examples.chinese: 谈判破裂，双方已无话可说。
examples.english: With talks collapsed, the two sides had nothing left to say.

lessons.title: 话语标记：综上所述、总而言之、归根到底等
lessons.explanation: Summing-up discourse markers: "in summary / all in all / in the final analysis".

examples.chinese: 综上所述，本方案切实可行。
examples.english: To sum up, this plan is practical and feasible.

lessons.title: 话语标记：换句话说、话说回来、退一步说等
lessons.explanation: Reformulating and conceding markers: "in other words / then again / even granting that".

examples.chinese: 他没有明确反对，换句话说，尚有余地。
examples.english: He did not object outright; in other words, there is still room.

lessons.title: 话语标记：老实说、不瞒你说、说真的等
lessons.explanation: Frankness markers opening a candid remark: "honestly speaking / to tell the truth".

examples.chinese: 老实说，这个结果我并不意外。
examples.english: Honestly, this outcome does not surprise me.

lessons.title: X到这个地步/份上
lessons.explanation: "To such a point": marks an extreme, usually regrettable degree.

examples.chinese: 事情闹到这个地步，谁也不愿看到。
examples.english: Nobody wanted things to come to such a pass.

lessons.title: X得要命/要死
lessons.explanation: Extreme-degree complement: "terribly, to death".

examples.chinese: 三伏天里，机房闷得要命。
examples.english: In the dog days, the server room is stiflingly hot.

lessons.title: X都不/没X
lessons.explanation: Verb-copying emphasis: "without even V-ing".

examples.chinese: 他看都不看就把文件签了。
examples.english: He signed the document without so much as a glance.

lessons.title: X就X个Y
lessons.explanation: "If you are going to X, then X thoroughly": urges doing something wholeheartedly.

examples.chinese: 要干就干个漂亮，别拖泥带水。
examples.english: If you are going to do it, do it brilliantly: no half measures.

lessons.title: X了Y，Y了X
lessons.explanation: Cyclic alternation of two verbs: doing one then the other, on and on.

examples.chinese: 假期里他吃了睡，睡了吃。
examples.english: On holiday he did nothing but eat then sleep, sleep then eat.

lessons.title: X也好，Y也罢
lessons.explanation: "Whether X or Y, either way": concessive listing of alternatives.

examples.chinese: 同意也好，反对也罢，请说明理由。
examples.english: Agree or object, either way, please give your reasons.

lessons.title: 别提（有）多+形容词+了
lessons.explanation: "Indescribably (adjective)": exclamatory intensifier.

examples.chinese: 拿到录取通知那天，他别提多高兴了。
examples.english: The day the admission letter came, he was indescribably happy.

lessons.title: 不亚于……
lessons.explanation: "No less than, second to none compared with".

examples.chinese: 她的中文水平不亚于母语者。
examples.english: Her Chinese is no worse than a native speaker’s.

lessons.title: 不知X是/才好
lessons.explanation: "Not know what one should best do/say": expresses being at a loss.

examples.chinese: 面对众人的夸奖，她不知说什么才好。
examples.english: Faced with everyone’s praise, she did not know what to say.

lessons.title: 动不动就……
lessons.explanation: "At the slightest provocation, apt to": criticizes over-frequent behavior.

examples.chinese: 他动不动就拿辞职要挟人。
examples.english: He threatens to resign at the drop of a hat.

lessons.title: 动词+（得）个X
lessons.explanation: V+个+complement: casual emphatic result, e.g. 输了个彻底, 玩个痛快.

examples.chinese: 这场球他们输了个彻底。
examples.english: They lost that match utterly.

lessons.title: 该X（就）X，该Y（就）Y
lessons.explanation: "Do X when X is due, do Y when Y is due": life goes on as it should.

examples.chinese: 该吃吃，该睡睡，别自己吓自己。
examples.english: Eat when you should, sleep when you should: stop scaring yourself.

lessons.title: 何至于……
lessons.explanation: Rhetorical "how could it have come to…": things need not have gone this far.

examples.chinese: 早些体检，何至于拖成大病？
examples.english: With earlier checkups, how could it have become so serious?

lessons.title: 仅次于X
lessons.explanation: "Second only to".

examples.chinese: 该市经济总量仅次于省会。
examples.english: The city’s economic output is second only to the provincial capital’s.

lessons.title: 看在X的面子上
lessons.explanation: "For the sake of, out of consideration for (someone’s face)".

examples.chinese: 看在老同学的面子上，这次就算了。
examples.english: For an old classmate’s sake, let it go this once.

lessons.title: 有/没什么+动词+头儿
lessons.explanation: V+头儿 "worth of V-ing": whether something is worth doing.

examples.chinese: 剧情老套，这部剧没什么看头儿。
examples.english: With such a clichéd plot, this show is hardly worth watching.

lessons.title: 没什么好+动词+的
lessons.explanation: "There is nothing worth V-ing about": dismisses the need for an action.

examples.chinese: 事实摆在眼前，没什么好争的。
examples.english: The facts are plain. There is nothing to argue about.

lessons.title: 莫过于……
lessons.explanation: "Nothing surpasses; the greatest … is".

examples.chinese: 人生至乐，莫过于家人平安团聚。
examples.english: Life’s greatest joy is nothing other than family safe and reunited.

lessons.title: 你说你一个X，……
lessons.explanation: Reproachful opener: "you, of all people, a X, how could you…".

examples.chinese: 你说你一个大人，怎么跟孩子计较？
examples.english: You, a grown-up. How can you bicker with a child?

lessons.title: 什么A的B的
lessons.explanation: Loose enumeration "things like A and B and so on".

examples.chinese: 什么吃的用的，母亲都备齐了。
examples.english: Food, daily necessities and the like: mother prepared it all.

lessons.title: 视……而定
lessons.explanation: "To be decided depending on…".

examples.chinese: 是否延期，视天气情况而定。
examples.english: Whether to postpone depends on the weather.

lessons.title: 谈何……
lessons.explanation: Rhetorical "how can one even speak of…": far easier said than done.

examples.chinese: 资金短缺，扩大生产谈何容易。
examples.english: With funds short, expanding production is easier said than done.

lessons.title: 无非/不过/只是……罢了/而已
lessons.explanation: "Nothing more than… that is all": downplays significance.

examples.chinese: 他这样说，无非是想安慰你罢了。
examples.english: He said that merely to comfort you, nothing more.

lessons.title: 想X之所想，急X之所急
lessons.explanation: "Think what X thinks, feel the urgency X feels": total devotion to someone’s needs.

examples.chinese: 企业要想用户之所想，急用户之所急。
examples.english: A business must think what users think and feel their urgencies.

lessons.title: 向……致以……
lessons.explanation: Formal formula for extending greetings, thanks or respects.

examples.chinese: 谨向全体医护人员致以崇高的敬意。
examples.english: We extend our highest respects to all medical workers.

lessons.title: 要X有/没X，要Y有/没Y
lessons.explanation: "Has X when you want X, Y when you want Y": everything (or nothing) one could ask.

examples.chinese: 这地方要山有山，要水有水。
examples.english: This place has mountains if you want them, and water too.

lessons.title: 因……而……
lessons.explanation: Formal cause frame: "because of…, therefore…".

examples.chinese: 航班因大雾而延误。
examples.english: The flight was delayed on account of heavy fog.

lessons.title: 有何X
lessons.explanation: Formal interrogative "what … is there": 有何看法/意见/深意.

examples.chinese: 此举有何深意，外界众说纷纭。
examples.english: What deeper meaning this move carries, opinions vary widely.

lessons.title: （在）……之余
lessons.explanation: "In the time left over from…; beyond (doing)…".

examples.chinese: 工作之余，他坚持写作。
examples.english: Outside of work, he keeps up his writing.

lessons.title: 值此……之际，……
lessons.explanation: Ceremonial opener: "on the occasion of…".

examples.chinese: 值此建校百年之际，谨致贺忱。
examples.english: On the centenary of the school’s founding, we offer congratulations.

lessons.title: 比较句"A+形容词+于/过+B"
lessons.explanation: Literary comparison with 于/过 after the adjective: 高于, 强过.

examples.chinese: 今年的销量明显高于去年。
examples.english: This year’s sales are clearly higher than last year’s.

lessons.title: 一来……，二来……（，三来……）
lessons.explanation: Parallel listing of reasons: "for one thing…, for another…".

examples.chinese: 他搬家一来图上班近，二来图环境好。
examples.english: He moved partly for the short commute, partly for the environment.

lessons.title: 一则……，二则……（，三则……）
lessons.explanation: Formal enumeration of reasons: "firstly…, secondly…".

examples.chinese: 项目搁浅，一则预算有限，二则人手不足。
examples.english: The project stalled: first, the budget was tight; second, staff were short.

lessons.title: 所谓……，就是……
lessons.explanation: Expository definition: "what is called X is precisely Y".

examples.chinese: 所谓终身学习，就是把学习变成习惯。
examples.english: So-called lifelong learning means making learning a habit.

lessons.title: 或……，或……
lessons.explanation: Literary alternative listing: "either… or…; now… now…".

examples.chinese: 周末他或读书，或爬山，从不虚度。
examples.english: On weekends he reads or hikes, never idling.

lessons.title: 宁可/宁愿……，也不……
lessons.explanation: Preference by sacrifice: "would rather… than…".

examples.chinese: 他宁可通宵加班，也不敷衍了事。
examples.english: He would rather work all night than do a slapdash job.

lessons.title: 与其……，宁愿/宁可……
lessons.explanation: Comparative preference: "rather than…, one would prefer to…".

examples.chinese: 与其坐等机会，宁可主动出击。
examples.english: Rather than wait for chances, better to take the initiative.

lessons.title: X（倒）是X（了），……
lessons.explanation: Concessive echo: "X it may be, but…".

examples.chinese: 东西好倒是好，就是价格偏高。
examples.english: Good it certainly is, only the price is on the high side.

lessons.title: 别看……，……
lessons.explanation: "Never mind that…; despite appearances…".

examples.chinese: 别看他年纪小，主意却不少。
examples.english: Never mind his age. He is full of ideas.

lessons.title: 虽说……，但/可……
lessons.explanation: Colloquial-formal concession: "though admittedly…, yet…".

examples.chinese: 虽说条件艰苦，但大家干劲十足。
examples.english: Though conditions are hard, everyone is full of drive.

lessons.title: 无论……与否，都……
lessons.explanation: Unconditional with 与否 "whether or not".

examples.chinese: 无论成功与否，这次尝试都值得。
examples.english: Successful or not, the attempt is worthwhile.

lessons.title: 凡……（者），均（可）……
lessons.explanation: Formal universal condition: "whoever/whatever…, all…".

examples.chinese: 凡年满十八周岁者，均可报名。
examples.english: All who have reached eighteen may register.

lessons.title: 假若/假使……，……
lessons.explanation: Literary hypothesis: "if, supposing".

examples.chinese: 假若当初听劝，何至于此？
examples.english: Had he heeded the advice back then, would it have come to this?

lessons.title: 幸亏/幸好……，不然/否则……
lessons.explanation: "Luckily…, otherwise…".

examples.chinese: 幸亏出门早，不然就误了高铁。
examples.english: Luckily we left early, or we would have missed the train.

lessons.title: 纵然/纵使……，也……
lessons.explanation: Literary concession: "even if…, still…".

examples.chinese: 纵然困难重重，我们也绝不言弃。
examples.english: Even with difficulties piled high, we will never speak of giving up.

lessons.title: （因）……，故……
lessons.explanation: Literary cause-effect with 故 "therefore".

examples.chinese: 因证据不足，故本案暂缓审理。
examples.english: As evidence is insufficient, the case is therefore postponed.

lessons.title: ……，以至（于）……
lessons.explanation: Result reaching an extreme: "to the point that".

examples.chinese: 他专心于实验，以至忘了吃饭。
examples.english: He was so absorbed in the experiment that he forgot to eat.

lessons.title: 别说……，都/也……
lessons.explanation: Escalation: "to say nothing of…, even…".

examples.chinese: 别说熬夜了，他连晚饭都顾不上吃。
examples.english: Never mind staying up late. He cannot even manage dinner.

lessons.title: ……不说，还……
lessons.explanation: Piling on: "not to mention…, on top of that…".

examples.chinese: 这款手机贵不说，还特别费电。
examples.english: This phone is expensive, and on top of that it drains the battery.

lessons.title: （连……都……，）更不用说……了
lessons.explanation: "Even X…, let alone Y": a fortiori escalation.

examples.chinese: 他连方言都能听懂，更不用说普通话了。
examples.english: He understands even dialects, let alone Mandarin.

lessons.title: ……尚且……，（更）何况……
lessons.explanation: "Even… is the case, how much more so…".

examples.chinese: 专家尚且难下结论，何况外行呢？
examples.english: Even experts struggle to conclude. How much more so laypeople?

lessons.title: 为（了）……起见，……
lessons.explanation: Purpose formula: "for the sake of…".

examples.chinese: 为安全起见，请系好安全带。
examples.english: For safety’s sake, please fasten your seat belt.

lessons.title: ……，以……
lessons.explanation: Formal purpose clause introduced by 以 "so as to".

examples.chinese: 公司优化了流程，以提高生产效率。
examples.english: The company streamlined its processes so as to raise efficiency.

lessons.title: 非得……才……
lessons.explanation: Condensed necessity: "only if… will…; it takes… before…".

examples.chinese: 这台设备非得专业人员才能维修。
examples.english: Only a professional can repair this piece of equipment.

lessons.title: 任……也……
lessons.explanation: Condensed concession: "no matter how…, still…".

examples.chinese: 任大家怎么劝，他也不肯松口。
examples.english: No matter how everyone urged, he would not budge.
